name: PCBE multi-identity reuse capsule

live_repository_reads.content_semantics_used: Manifest UTF-8 was readable, but the rule below admits only its exact path/blob identity.

precommitted_rule.meaning: RELEASE_OK=1 iff the declared release mode is 1 and both bound role-local repository paths have the exact expected Git blob identities.

tests.derivation: outer IF selects 0 before identity branches
config passes; manifest DIGEST_EQ=0; manifest IF selects 0
config and manifest pass; payload DIGEST_EQ=0; payload IF selects 0

scaling_observation.scope: two independent repository identities in a nested finite decision
scaling_observation.comparison_to_single_identity_r148: one additional identity adds one repository SHA read, one DIGEST_EQ check and one additional decision layer; no binary byte readback or execution is introduced

result.useful_outcome: A scheduled-Chat decision can gate reuse of an already-published multi-file capsule on both exact content identities plus declared configuration, failing closed on stale/mismatched metadata without rebuilding or executing the artifact.
limits: Identity-only; does not prove arbitrary payload bytes or executable behavior.
The manifest and payload must already exist.
Declared RELEASE_MODE remains conditional input, not measured ambient state.
This does not perform the post-gate external release side effect.

frontier: Use a readable manifest that binds payload identity to turn some semantic claims into text-verifiable claims without reading the binary; test manifest/payload cross-binding consistency.
Test stale manifest that names the old payload SHA while payload path changes; require the composed certificate to reject even if both individual paths are readable.
Audit provider-verified signed-attestation status surfaces versus raw signatures.
